svg.title: Setpoint change and load change on the water heater
svg.desc: In the setpoint trial the heater command jumps to 81.15 percent before the water moves, and the temperature is inside 0.2 degrees Celsius of 38 from 23.4 seconds. In the load trial the command stays at 75 percent until the water cools, the temperature falls to 33.32 degrees and is outside 0.2 degrees of 35 until 30.4 seconds.
svg.text: Setpoint change and load change on the water heater
Simulator runs of this project · two separate 60 s trials from 35 °C · numbers answer the predictions
Outside 0.2 °C until 30.4 s: fails by 0.4 s
